records.summary: Added Circle's full official Arc launch specification and corrected the earlier secondary-only StableFX scope: 22 local stablecoins are active or onboarding; Circle Payments Network is natively integrated; SBI Group is a founding validator and explicitly describes USDC/JPYSC collaboration; Coinbase is an exchange-access partner, not a validator. Added Aave risk-steward data on RLUSD Horizon and Arc USDC reserve utilization, slope2 and borrow/draw-cap changes, the staged unfreeze and nine zero-LTV assets. Added the official Binance PoR page's Download All Address control but the dynamic target remains inaccessible. Reconciled three divergent XRP ETF trackers and three incompatible open-interest series; no market feature admitted and no forecast issued. Audited current main and exact-head PR CI, including the MMI task-bundle blocker.
